text: Moss stores metadata as string values: every metadata value is a string in all SDKs. Numbers and booleans passed to create_index or add_docs in Python 1.18.0+ are stored as strings (30 becomes "30", True becomes "true"/"false"). To filter a boolean you added as Python True, use the string form: {"field": "flag", "condition": {"$eq": "true"}}, not Python True. Filters are evaluated on the loaded index, so call load_index() (or open a session) first.
